narrative.synopsis: Priam crosses enemy lines with Hermes as divine escort so he can beg Achilles for Hector’s body. The episode turns on grief shared between enemies and ends with a temporary mercy that allows Trojan burial rites.
narrative.openingSituation: Hector is dead and Achilles still holds the body outside Troy.
narrative.centralConflict: Priam must enter the camp of the man who killed his son and trust divine guidance rather than royal power.
narrative.resolution: Achilles accepts ransom, returns Hector, and grants time for burial.
narrative.outcome: The war pauses long enough for human grief to override rage.

events.consequence: Zeus orders Hermes to guard the old king.
